title: 2026 CMA Awards Nominations: Here’s How to Watch the Livestream Announcement
summary: The nods for the 60th annual CMA Awards will be announced Sept. 10.
contentText:
Country music fans can watch the nominations for the 60th annual CMA Awards as they are revealed by  Good Morning America ’s Lara Spencer on the ABC morning show on Thursday (Sept. 10).

Spencer will announce nominees in key categories from New York, and then starting at 9 a.m ET/8 a.m. CT/6 a.m. PT, Lee Ann Womack and  American Idol  season 24 winner Hannah Harper will host a livestream from Nashville on the CMA YouTube channel to announce the full list. Womack certainly can relate to the potential nominees’ nerves, having been nominated 17 times herself. She has taken home six CMA Awards over her career, including for album of the year for There’s More Where That Came From in 2005 and single and song of the year for “I Hope You Dance” in 2000.

The 2026 CMA Awards will take place Nov. 18 from Nashville’s Bridgestone Arena with Lainey Wilson returning to host the third time . Wilson is the reigning entertainer of the year, and she’ll likely face stiff competition this year from her four fellow nominees. While the nominations won’t be revealed until Thursday morning, it’s hard to imagine that Ella Langley and her hit song “Choosin’ Texas,” which is spending its 21st week at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 , won’t be a leading contender.

The CMA Awards will air live on ABC and, for the first time, simultaneously stream on Disney+ and will stream on Hulu the next day.  Tickets will go on sale Sept. 18 at 11 a.m. ET. For more details, visit the CMA Awards ‘ website .
